lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.
Predictions were too high for failed tests: both [adoption, redesign] (predicted +14.0%, actual -7.4%) and [sign_in, reorder] (predicted +6.0%, actual -7.4%) yielded negative results.
Predictions were too low for winning tests: [finish, redesign] exceeded expectations (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.0%).

candidates.title: Interactive Story Scroll Path Choice
candidates.change: Redesign the story screen into an interactive story scroll layout with mascot presentation to engage users before path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% with a high mean time of 514s, suggesting users feel unengaged or hesitant at the start.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Discover a personalized virtual companion that lives right on your desktop display.

guard.reason: Redesign retains the story purpose of introducing the companion.

candidates.score_note: Targeted step has 23.8% drop, but flow redesigns carry high risk and high cost without support mail confirmation.

candidates.title: Desktop Interaction Modes Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated post-intro screen explaining primary pet interaction controls such as tray positioning and chat.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop

new_interaction_guide.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_interaction_guide.body: Right-click your pet anytime on your desktop to access quick actions, hide to system tray, or start chat.

guard.reason: Adds a valid new interaction guide screen following home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 3 support emails on finish step, but adding a new screen requires release and build effort.

candidates.title: Live Breed Selection Carousel
candidates.change: Transform companion selection into an interactive audio-visual carousel experience.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a high drop-off rate of 39.1% and a long mean time of 1017s.

pick_friend.headline: Meet Your Potential Companions
pick_friend.body: Swipe through different companion breeds and hear their unique sounds.

guard.reason: Carousel redesign retains the function of selecting a pet companion.

candidates.score_note: Highest drop-off step (39.1%), but past adoption redesign failed (-7.4%) and cost is high.

candidates.title: Progressive Waiting Status Checklist
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with a live stage-by-stage checklist layout showing pet generation progress.
candidates.why: The waiting phase has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user drop-off while waiting without feedback.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are generating your pet's custom graphics, sound effects, and desktop behaviors.

guard.reason: Checklist redesign maintains the waiting screen job of showing pet creation progress.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time (201s), but requires major UI layout rebuild.

candidates.title: Account Synchronization Benefit Copy
candidates.change: Update sign in copy to explicitly state that account sign-in backs up and synchronizes pet data to cloud.
candidates.why: 8 support emails cited missing or reset pets after signing in again, showing confusion around account persistence.

sign_in.headline: Sync Your Pet to Your Account
sign_in.body: Signing in ensures your pet's memories, level, and custom appearance are safely backed up in the cloud.

guard.reason: Copy update clearly states cloud sync benefits without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: 8 support emails directly address this issue; copy change is config-only with high potential ROI.

candidates.title: Path Decision Speed Hint
candidates.change: Display a helpful hint on path selection explaining that companion choices can be changed later in app settings.
candidates.why: Choose path mean time is 514s compared to 8s median, showing a long tail of users struggling to decide.

choose_path.hint: Don't worry! You can easily change your companion type later in App Settings.

guard.reason: Adding a decision hint to choose_path is valid and helpful.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint targeted at high mean time (514s vs 8s median) to reduce decision hesitation.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Entertainment Tips
candidates.change: Add an engaging tip carousel to the waiting screen that displays pet care advice while files render.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes a median of 201s, during which disengaged users leave or assume the app froze.

components.text: Tip: Feed your pet daily to build affection!

guard.reason: Adding an entertainment tip carousel to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Engages users during 201s median wait with low risk of breaking conversion flow.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Customization Highlight
candidates.change: Prominently feature pet naming input with an official companion badge on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops 39.1% of users; highlighting pet ownership and naming builds emotional connection.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Give your new companion a name to finalize their desktop adoption.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[1]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility Confirmation Toast
candidates.change: Add a clear status hint on the home intro screen letting users know where on their desktop screen the pet is placed.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported that the pet did not show up on the desktop after completing onboarding.

home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Check your taskbar or system tray if minimized.
home_intro.hint: Pet icon added to your primary display.

guard.reason: Adding desktop positioning guidance to home_intro is valid.

candidates.score_note: Strong support mail alignment, simple toast component, and finish step changes previously succeeded.

candidates.title: Compact Sign In Credentials Layout
candidates.change: Re-architect the sign-in screen into a compact layout with prominent provider buttons for faster authorization.
candidates.why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with mean time 567s, and users report sign-in screen stalling or failing.

sign_in.headline: Quick Sign In
sign_in.body: Connect your account to save your companion's progress.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin to establish rules on which kinds of change work or fail, as each kind of change has only one test so far.

Predictions were consistently too high for failed tests: [adoption, redesign] (predicted +14.0%, actual -7.7%), [sign_in, reorder] (predicted +6.0%, actual -7.6%), and [finish, new_screen] (predicted +4.0%, actual -6.4%) all yielded negative results.
Predictions were too low for winning tests: [finish, redesign] exceeded expectations (predicted +3.0%, actual +5.2%).
